current_role: Co-founder of Facebook and Asana; co-founder of Good Ventures and the philanthropy Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy)
summary: Dustin Moskovitz co-founded Facebook in 2004 and the work-software company Asana in 2008, leading Asana until 2025. With his wife Cari Tuna he runs Good Ventures and Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy), major funders of global health and AI-safety work, including early grants to OpenAI. He is one of the largest Democratic donors, mainly through the super PAC Future Forward.
